boundaries: Advice with といい and the composite ように〜てほしい remain recognition/reuse, not newly scored targets.
Plain and polite wish clauses can overlap in use. The formation tasks explicitly request a register; wrong-register feedback does not declare it universally ungrammatical.
Short plain hope forms exclude the formal copula である by visible operation. Copular ない negatives include でない, ではない, じゃない and じゃあない; とよい is accepted.
No religious setting, control restriction, promised outcome, numerical certainty or compulsory な/ね beneficiary rule is inferred.

New groups are in the existing wishes chapter. They teach the stated conversions and interpret supplied clauses; no unsupplied potential derivation or new immediate prerequisite operation is introduced.
